verdict.rationale: Separating transactional from marketing email is a fair question for an email platform like MailerLite, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers transactional sending, separate templates, separate suppression rules or separate sending reputation. The cited items cover marketing campaigns, automations, webhooks and editors only, so there is no support for a receipt reaching an unsubscribed contact.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
